imagegen.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: transparent hero cutout for a light cheerful Russian mobile app store campaign NEBO. Primary request: one original adult woman about 28 years old, waist-up to mid-thigh, naturally attractive with warm normal human features, shoulder-length dark brown hair, wearing a relaxed cobalt blue knitted sweater and cream trousers, slightly turned three quarters, holding a small plain coral smartphone with its BACK visible in one hand at chest height, looking at it with a quiet bright interested smile. Her other arm relaxed. Contemporary candid editorial lifestyle photography, natural skin texture, lovely warm daylight, fresh optimistic everyday feeling, realistic believable proportions and hands. Clean professional cutout with a broad continuous ivory paper die-cut border around the whole figure, subtle tactile paper edge, no cast shadow backdrop. Vertical figure with entire head and elbows within frame; figure occupies most of the canvas, enough clear space at all sides to preserve the die-cut outline. Real transparent background. No text, lettering, logos, jewelry symbols, zodiac symbols, glitter, crystal balls, moons, special powers, glossy fashion look, sexualized styling, app UI, invented screen contents, extra people or objects. A believable real adult user reading her phone, to combine later with real app screenshots and existing paper sun/cloud stickers. Warm cream and blue color palette.

recommendationReason: Broad recognizable zodiac entry, followed by personal forecast and natal chart; design hypothesis, not a proven conversion winner.
